req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update a post when the correct endpoint is called by the post's author. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful update, a negative test to ensure unauthorized users cannot update posts, and a boundary test to check behavior with minimal valid input.

tests.name: test_update_post_success
actions: Call POST /<id>/update with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'user', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Old Title', 'body': 'Old Body'})

# Update the post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'New Title', 'body': 'New Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_unauthorized
preconditions: User A has created a post
actions: User B attempts to update User A's post
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login User A
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'passA'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'passA'})

# User A creates a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Title A', 'body': 'Body A'})

# Register and login User B
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userB', 'password': 'passB'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userB', 'password': 'passB'})

# User B attempts to update User A's post
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Title B', 'body': 'Body B'})
assert r.status_code == 403
